reason: Chunk-Level Guided Generation uses a larger off-the-shelf LLM to score fixed-length candidate chunks during a small model’s generation; it is a test-time reasoning/search method, not speculative decoding or a serving/latency optimization. It is adjacent to the linked inference-time decoding family, but the full text provides no efficiency claim and adds scorer computation, so retain as borderline for lineage review.
title: Off-the-Shelf LLMs as Process Scorers: Training-Free Alternative to PRMs for Mathematical Reasoning
